table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, 
			itemalias=max(item.customicode),
			packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
			users.username,   
			headerno = dbo.quotationheader.headerno,
			dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,   
         dbo.quotationheader.date,
         invdiscperc=dbo.quotationheader.discperc,   
         invmischarg=dbo.quotationheader.misccharges,   
         invflatdisc=dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,   
         dbo.quotationheader.salestax,   
         dbo.quotationheader.custcode,   
         dbo.quotationheader.remarks,   
         dbo.quotationdetail.icode,   
			Id        = MAX(dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
			qty   = sum(quotationdetail.qty), 
			packunits = max(quotationdetail.packunits), 
	 		saleprice = max(quotationdetail.saleprice), 
         salestax  = max(quotationdetail.salestax),   
         detaildiscperc  = max(quotationdetail.discperc), 
			customername='                                  '  ,
			itemflatdisc  = max(quotationdetail.itemflatdisc),
			packsaleprice=max(item.saleprice),
			packpurprice=max(item.purprice),
			manufacturer=max(manufacturer.name),
			customername=max(accounts.name),
			customerali=max(accounts.aliasname),
			address1=(select customer.address1 from customer where custcode=quotationheader.custcode),
			address2=(select customer.address2 from customer where custcode=quotationheader.custcode),
			custlisc=(select customer.licenceno from customer where custcode=quotationheader.custcode),
			city=(select customer.city from customer where custcode=quotationheader.custcode)
    FROM dbo.quotationheader,   
         dbo.quotationdetail,  
         item,
			Users ,
			manufacturer,
		   accounts

   WHERE ( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
			( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode ) AND 
			( quotationheader.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
			( quotationheader.custcode=accounts.acccode) and
			( quotationdetail.icode = item.icode )and
			(Item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)

GROUP BY quotationheader.quotationcode, 
			quotationheader.date, 
			quotationheader.custcode, 
			quotationheader.discperc, 
			quotationheader.flatdisc, 
			quotationheader.misccharges, 
			quotationheader.headerno,
			quotationheader.salestax, 
			quotationheader.remarks, 
			quotationdetail.icode, 
			
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			users.username
ORDER BY 	
			max(manufacturer.name),
			item.name
		/*MAX(dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL)*/

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) - invflatdisc  +  invmischarg   +  salestax  , 0)
